body.x: HWASHIN participated in the ‘CES 2017 (Consumer Technology Show) that is the world’s largest IT consumer electronics and consumer technology tradeshow held in Las Vegas in the United States from January 5th to January 8th as a Daegu Common Facility for the 3D Convergence Support Project of Daegu Technopark and exhibited a motor controller, driving button controller, and others for an electric scooter and car.

The higher people recognize the recent environmental issues, the higher they are interested in an electric car and eco-friendly mobility. HWANSHIN manufactures proper car goods for the eco-friendly age as well as car sashes and body components and supply them using OEM. In this show, the company placed a motor controller and driving button controller for an electric scooter and car.

A senior researcher of the company, Yeo In Joo, said, “We took part in this show to promote our products and skills. We came here to figure out what kind of skills were in demand globally and at what scale the market was.”
HWASHIN has five factories including domestic subsidiaries as a main base of production and have entered the oversea markets in the United States, India, China, Brazil, and other countries.

The Daegu Technopark and Smart Venture Institute and Smart Drone Technology Center of Kyungpook National University opened ‘CES Daegu Common Facility’ and supported the exhibition operation of 22 domestic enterprises and business meeting with a buyer.

CES (Consumer Technology Show), which is the world’s largest IT consumer electronics and consumer technology tradeshow, is a good opportunity to figure out the flow of the global electronic industry at a glance and is held on every January by CTA (Consumer Technology Association).

Aving News Korea, which have reported issues of CES, MWC, and IFA as the world’ three major technology exhibitions the most for the last 10 years, will send a special group of reporters to CES, report main issues of the markets, and introduce Korean enterprises all over the world this year.
